project_metadata.title: 青蛙王子與金球
project_metadata.global_style_prompt: Digital storybook illustration, vibrant Pixar style, 3D render feel, rich fairy tale mood, soft cinematic lighting, highly detailed environments.

character_master.name: 公主
character_master.body_features: Young beautiful girl, pale skin, rosy cheeks, long blonde curly hair.
character_master.outfit: Elegant pink royal gown with gold embroidery.

environment.location: A grand castle garden with blooming roses and a beautiful stone fountain.
environment.key_elements: A shiny golden ball flying in the air.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm morning sunlight casting soft shadows, cheerful and peaceful atmosphere.

scenes.narration: 早晨的陽光灑滿城堡花園。公主開心地把最珍貴的金球拋向空中，臉上洋溢著幸福的笑容。
scenes.image_prompt: Throwing a shiny golden ball into the air with a bright, joyful smile. Wide shot.

environment.location: An old stone well deep inside the garden.
environment.key_elements: Dark water inside the well, splashing water droplets.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dappled sunlight hitting the stone well, dramatic shadow inside the well.

scenes.narration: 突然，一個不小心，金球從她的手中滑落，撲通一聲掉進了深邃的水井裡，消失不見了。
scenes.image_prompt: Leaning over the stone edge, reaching out desperately as the ball falls into the dark water. Medium shot.

environment.key_elements: A small green frog sitting on a mossy stone.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft lighting focusing on the emotional faces, slightly melancholic.

scenes.narration: 公主坐在井邊，眼裡泛起淚光難過地哭泣。「為甚麼這麼傷心呢？」一個溫和的聲音響起。
scenes.image_prompt: Sitting on the ground, wiping tears from the eyes, looking down at the small green frog. Close-up shot.

environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright sunlight returning, feeling of hope.

scenes.narration: 青蛙歪著頭說：「我可以幫你撿回金球，但你要答應讓我住進城堡，和你一起吃飯睡覺。」
scenes.image_prompt: Nodding eagerly while wiping away tears, looking at the frog with a surprised expression. Medium shot.

environment.key_elements: The wet green frog holding the golden ball.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Sparkling water drops catching the sunlight, joyful and vibrant.

scenes.narration: 為了拿回最愛的玩具，公主點頭答應了。青蛙立刻跳進井裡，沒多久就把金球叼了上來。
scenes.image_prompt: Holding the shiny golden ball joyfully, kneeling next to the wet frog on the stone edge. Wide shot.

environment.location: A stone path leading to the grand castle.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright and airy, conveying a sense of fast movement.

scenes.narration: 公主拿回金球高興極了，轉身就往城堡跑去，把可憐的青蛙和自己的承諾全都拋在腦後。
scenes.image_prompt: Running away happily towards the background, hugging the ball tightly, leaving the frog behind. Medium shot.

environment.key_elements: Long wooden table with a feast, a grand open wooden door, a frog at the door.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm glow from massive crystal chandeliers, dramatic shadows near the entrance.

scenes.narration: 當晚，國王和公主正在享用晚餐。突然傳來敲門聲，原來是那隻青蛙來要求公主履行諾言。
scenes.image_prompt: Sitting at the dining table, looking shocked and guilty towards the open grand door. Wide shot.

environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm but intimate candlelight, emphasizing the emotional tension.

scenes.narration: 國王嚴肅地說：「孩子，你答應過的事情，必須履行。」公主只好不情願地讓青蛙進來。
scenes.image_prompt: Looking down at the floor with an embarrassed and reluctant expression, hands fidgeting. Close-up shot.

environment.key_elements: Large bed with silk sheets, fluffy pillows, the green frog sitting on the pillow.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool silver moonlight streaming through the window, contrasting with warm bedside lamps.

scenes.narration: 那天晚上，青蛙甚至爬上了公主的枕頭。她雖然心裡極度不舒服，但也只能無奈地忍耐著。
scenes.image_prompt: Laying in bed with furrowed brows and a highly uncomfortable expression, looking sideways at the pillow. Medium shot.

environment.key_elements: Blooming potted flowers, an elegant tea table.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm, pleasant afternoon light, relaxing and harmonious vibe.

scenes.narration: 日子一天天過去，青蛙每天溫柔體貼地陪伴著公主。漸漸地，公主發現自己不再討厭牠了。
scenes.image_prompt: Sitting at the table, smiling warmly and gently chatting with the small frog companion. Wide shot.

environment.location: Cozy reading room in the castle.
environment.key_elements: Bookshelves, a velvet armchair, the frog.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Sunset light coming through the window, creating a melancholic but warm mood.

scenes.narration: 有一天，公主因為好朋友要搬走而難過大哭。青蛙輕聲安慰：「別怕，我會永遠陪著你。」
scenes.image_prompt: Crying softly with hands covering the face, while the frog lightly touches her arm. Medium shot.

environment.location: Cozy reading room in the castle.
environment.key_elements: The frog sitting on the armrest.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm, romantic golden hour lighting focusing entirely on the faces.

scenes.narration: 公主聽後擦乾眼淚，覺得非常幸福。她笑著對青蛙說了聲謝謝，然後輕輕在牠的額頭上吻了一下。
scenes.image_prompt: Closing eyes peacefully, leaning in and gently kissing the frog on the forehead with a grateful smile. Close-up shot.

environment.location: Cozy reading room in the castle.
environment.key_elements: Floating magical sparkles, bright glowing light replacing the frog.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Intense magical glowing light overpowering the sunset, dramatic and miraculous atmosphere.

scenes.narration: 突然，青蛙的身體閃爍出耀眼的光芒！牠的身形漸漸變化，竟然變成了一位英俊的王子。
scenes.image_prompt: Gasping with wide eyes, stepping back in pure astonishment as a magical glowing light surrounds them. Wide shot.

environment.location: Cozy reading room in the castle.
environment.key_elements: A handsome prince in royal attire.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm and gentle lighting, magical dust slowly settling down.

scenes.narration: 王子微笑著解釋，自己是被巫婆詛咒的。多虧了公主的真心一吻，才終於解除了這個魔法。
scenes.image_prompt: Blushing with a shy but deeply happy smile, holding hands with the handsome prince. Medium shot.

environment.location: A grand fairytale wedding courtyard outside a majestic castle.
environment.key_elements: A beautiful royal carriage, colorful confetti in the air, cheering crowds.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Extremely bright, festive, and triumphant lighting, pure joy.

scenes.narration: 公主答應了王子的求婚。他們一起回到王子的國家舉行盛大婚禮，從此過著幸福快樂的生活。
scenes.image_prompt: Waving joyfully from a beautiful royal carriage, surrounded by cheering crowds and flying confetti. Wide shot.
